plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Woodworking Technology, Associate of Applied Science' program page (Major Code: 4540A), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/trade-and-industry-department/woodworking/woodworking-technology-associate-of-applied-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Applied Science (page title 'Woodworking Technology, Associate of Applied Science'; the program page lists BTC, ITC, and AAS awards - the AAS is the flagship degree modeled here). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester tables print 15/15/15/15 and sum exactly. Choice slots: PROG ELEC 3 credits (student choice from the official program-elective list: CABW 101, CABW 102, CABW 103, CABW 200I 1-3 cr, CABW 225, CABW 285 1-8 cr); MATH GE / SOCS GE / COMM GE / ELEC GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
